name: model_op_causal_conv1d_update
description: Decode-stage causal conv1d with in-place conv-state update (FlagGems-vllm PR #725, causal_conv1d_update). x [batch, dim] or [batch, dim, seqlen] float16/bfloat16/float32; conv_state [num_slots, dim, state_len] with state_len >= width-1, gathered per sequence by conv_state_indices [batch] int32 where pad_slot_id marks padded rows to skip; weight [dim, width]; optional bias [dim]; activation None or 'silu'. For each live sequence the new tokens are appended to that slot's cached state, the width-tap causal convolution is evaluated over the last seqlen positions, and the trailing state_len columns of concat(state, x) are written back into conv_state in place. Returns the output shaped like x; conv_state is mutated in place.
